item.title: Getting Database Structure in MySQL
item.description: Understanding the structure of a MySQL database is crucial for effective database management. Retrieving information about tables, columns, indexes, and relationships allows database administrators and developers to analyze, optimize, and maintain the database. This article explores various methods for getting the database structure in MySQL. 1. SHOW TABLES: Use the SHOW TABLES statement to display a list of tables in the current database. SHOW TABLES; 2. DESCRIBE TABLE: The DESCRIBE or DESC statement provides information about the columns in a specific table.
